products.name: Eco Veg Box
products.shortDesc: Seasonal vegetables from local organic farms.
products.description: Our signature Eco Veg Box contains 5–7 varieties of seasonal, locally-sourced vegetables delivered fresh weekly. Every box supports organic farmers within 50 miles of you and arrives in compostable packaging.

products.name: Zero-Waste Starter Kit
products.shortDesc: Reusable bags, jars, and utensils to begin your zero-waste journey.
products.description: A complete kit of reusable produce bags, stainless-steel utensils, glass food jars, and beeswax wraps. Designed in collaboration with zero-waste educators.

products.name: Seasonal Fruit Basket
products.shortDesc: Fresh seasonal fruits from local orchards.
products.description: A weekly selection of seasonal, organic fruit from orchards within 50 miles. Perfect for smoothies, lunchboxes, or just keeping on the kitchen counter.

products.name: Herb Garden Kit
products.shortDesc: Grow your own herbs at home — seeds, soil, and biodegradable pots.
products.description: Five varieties of organic herb seeds (basil, parsley, coriander, mint, thyme), peat-free soil, and biodegradable coir pots. Indoor-friendly.

products.name: Bamboo Essentials
products.shortDesc: Sustainable bamboo kitchen and bathroom essentials.
products.description: Bamboo toothbrushes, cutlery, cotton buds, and dish brushes. Fully biodegradable and ethically sourced from FSC-certified suppliers.

products.name: Local Raw Honey
products.description: Raw, unprocessed honey from small-scale apiaries within 50 miles. Each jar supports wild pollinator habitat restoration.

workshops.name: Home Composting 101
workshops.shortDesc: Turn kitchen scraps into garden gold in 90 minutes.
workshops.description: A practical, hands-on workshop covering composting methods, troubleshooting common issues, and balancing greens and browns. Take home a starter bokashi kit.

workshops.name: Plant-Based Cooking Basics
workshops.description: A chef-led cooking workshop. Learn three plant-based meals using seasonal produce from our partner farms. All ingredients and equipment provided.

workshops.name: DIY Natural Cleaning Products
workshops.shortDesc: Replace your cleaning cupboard with safe, low-cost alternatives.
workshops.description: Make all-purpose spray, laundry powder, and dish soap from simple ingredients. Leave with bottles of each and full recipe cards.

events.name: Saturday Farmers Market
events.shortDesc: Weekly farmers market with 30+ local growers.
events.description: Our flagship Saturday market: seasonal produce, prepared food, live music, and free composting advice from our community team.

events.name: Community Tree Planting
events.shortDesc: Help plant 500 native trees along the canal.
events.description: Volunteer-led tree planting day. Tools, gloves, and lunch provided — bring a reusable water bottle. Suitable for all ages.
